name: resource-64mib-stream-matched
title: 64-segment resource stream · matched RNS policy
summary: Stream 64 maximum-efficient resource segments with both endpoint interfaces configured for RNS's 10 Mbps / 16 KiB policy.
notes: Controlled policy comparison: identical workload and protocol with both implementations configured for the stock RNS bitrate and MTU tier.

Both implementations carry the same 67,108,800-byte payload in 64 maximum-efficient protocol segments. This is 64 bytes below 64 MiB and avoids making benchmark completion depend on RNS {reference_version}'s timing-sensitive handoff to a 65th 64-byte tail segment.

cell_notes.text: RNS prepares the next 1 MiB segment in a background thread. Prns proves the current segment before that preparation completes, making RNS enter a coarse 50 ms polling loop. A slower stock receiver gives preparation enough time to finish, avoiding that cliff.

description: The 64-segment incompressible resource stream repeated with both real initiator and responder interfaces explicitly configured for 10 Mbps. That policy selects the 16,384-byte interface MTU tier on both stacks. Compression remains disabled and every segment remains encrypted, hash-proved, assembled, and application-acknowledged; this is the policy-matched counterpart to the default-policy result.
conformance: Every sent stream settles, receives its ordered application acknowledgement, and is received with exact application-byte totals and zero failures; each transfer is a sequence of hash-proved segments assembled by original_hash before the whole is counted.
